description: A talent booker must lock the final appearance package for actor Mara Vale at a filmed ScreenSound Expo conversation, including the stage format, timing, audience arrangement, press access, and recording permissions.

shared_context.S1: ScreenSound Expo will host a filmed conversation with actor Mara Vale at 6:20 PM in the Meridian Hall.
shared_context.S2: Leah makes the binding decision on the guest appearance package.
shared_context.S3: The draft event plan calls for a 45-minute standing interview, audience questions, admission for 600 people, open photography, and video recording.
shared_context.S4: The expo's daily production meeting requires Leah to lock the operational guest package after each functional lead reports changes; any paperwork still being filed is recorded as a follow-up and does not postpone that lock.

PF1.text: Jonah confirmed with Mara's agent this morning that Mara is available only from 6:20 PM to 6:55 PM, requires a seated two-chair interview, will not take audience questions, and will not permit photography; the agent's confirmation is still in Jonah's inbox and has not been entered in the show file.

PF2.text: Mina's post-rehearsal crowd assessment sets the safe audience limit at exactly 400 people and requires a full front barricade with two unobstructed side exit lanes; she is waiting for the daily production meeting to attach the signed assessment to the event file.

PF3.text: Rafael confirmed with the distributor that the conversation may be recorded for audio archives only, with no video recording or livestream, and that the archive must carry the credit 'ScreenSound Expo courtesy of Vale Archives'; the distributor's approval email is pending its formal rights-clearance attachment.

acceptance_conditions: The appearance must begin at exactly 6:20 PM and last exactly 35 minutes.
The conversation must use a seated two-chair format with no audience questions, and photography must be prohibited.
Admission must be capped at exactly 400 people with a full front barricade and two unobstructed side exit lanes.
Recording must be audio archive only, with no video recording or livestream.
The archive must carry the exact credit 'ScreenSound Expo courtesy of Vale Archives'.
The package must include commitments for the safety arrangement and rights-compliant recording.

content_checks.C2: decisions['stage_format'] == 'seated two-chair interview' and decisions['audience_questions'] == False and decisions['photography_allowed'] == False
content_checks.C3: decisions['audience_capacity'] == 400 and 'full front barricade' in decisions['barrier_plan'] and 'two unobstructed side exit lanes' in decisions['barrier_plan']
content_checks.C5: decisions['recording_mode'] == 'audio archives only' and decisions['livestream_allowed'] == False
content_checks.C7: decisions['barrier_plan'] == 'full front barricade with two unobstructed side exit lanes'
content_checks.C8: decisions['archive_credit'] == 'ScreenSound Expo courtesy of Vale Archives'
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'follow-up' and c['target'] == 'Rafael' and ('rights-clearance' in c['detail'] or 'rights clearance' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] == 'safety-arrangement' and c['target'] == 'Mina' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The agent's confirmed 6:20 PM-6:55 PM window changes the duration to exactly 35 minutes, changes the stage format to seated, removes audience questions, and changes photography from allowed to prohibited.

The signed crowd assessment changes admission from the draft 600 to exactly 400, changes the protection plan to a full front barricade with two unobstructed side exit lanes, and requires a safety-arrangement commitment targeting Mina.

The distributor's clearance changes recording from general video recording to audio archive only, prohibits livestreaming, changes the archive credit to the exact Vale Archives wording, and requires a follow-up commitment targeting Rafael to complete the formal rights-clearance attachment.
